variants.subject: {{firstName}}, question
variants.body:
{{personalization}}

{{RANDOM | Know this is out of left field, but | Out of left field, I know, but | Odd question, but}} if I could recover the money from accounts that cancelled or stopped renewing their contracts, in exchange for a commission on the ones I bring back, would you be open to it? I work mostly on performance and am building my network.

About me: I build client reactivation systems. I built a similar system for a commercial roofer doing $150M/year. I recovered about $6M worth of contracts within 6 months. {{RANDOM | Would cost you nothing upfront. | Nothing up front on your end. | Costs you nothing until an account comes back.}}

{{RANDOM | Let me know. | Worth a look? | Open to it?}}

{{RANDOM | Thanks, | Appreciate it, | Cheers,}}
Lorenzo

variants.subject: {{firstName}}, question
variants.body:
{{personalization}}

{{RANDOM | Quick one: | Straight to it: | Here is the short version:}} I build reactivation systems for commercial cleaning companies. I built a similar system for a commercial roofer doing $150M/year. I recovered about $6M worth of contracts within 6 months.

For {{companyName}} that means email and text sequences to every account that cancelled, stopped renewing, or never signed after the walkthrough. The ready ones book straight onto your calendar. {{RANDOM | Nothing up front, I only earn a cut of what comes back. | You pay nothing until an account comes back. | Commission only, on the accounts I actually bring back.}}

{{RANDOM | Easiest way to see if this is worth your time: | Lowest-effort next step: | If you want a quick read on it:}} send me your list of lost bids or former clients and I'll {{RANDOM | show you which ones are worth chasing | flag the ones worth chasing | mark which are worth a second run}}. Takes me a day, costs you nothing.

{{RANDOM | Thanks, | Appreciate it, | Talk soon,}}
Lorenzo

{{RANDOM | Hey | Hi | Hello}} {{firstName}},

{{RANDOM | Checking in, in case the first one got buried. | Bumping this in case it got buried. | Following up in case my last note slipped through.}} Quick version:
- I want to build a reactivation system for {{companyName}}. Goal is to bring back the accounts that cancelled or stopped renewing, without you chasing anyone.
- I did this for a commercial roofer doing $150M/yr and recovered about $6M in contracts in 6 months.
- Nothing up front. I only take a commission on the accounts I bring back.

{{RANDOM | Worth a quick 15 minute call? | Open to a quick 15 minute call? | Want to give it 15 minutes?}} Just reply yes and I'll send a calendar invite.

{{RANDOM | Thanks for the time, | Appreciate the time, | Thanks,}}
Lorenzo

{{RANDOM | Hey | Hi}} {{firstName}},

{{RANDOM | One question instead of another pitch. | Rather than pitch you again, one question. | One question, then I will leave it there.}} Does {{companyName}} still have a list of accounts that cancelled or walkthroughs that never closed, or has someone already worked through it?

For context: I did this for a commercial roofer doing $150M/yr and recovered about $6M in contracts in 6 months. Same mechanics, applied to your own lost accounts.

Either way the terms do not change. Nothing up front, and I only take a commission on the accounts that come back.

{{RANDOM | If the timing is wrong, reply 'not now' and I'll come back later in the year. | If it is not a priority, reply 'not now' and I'll leave it there. | Wrong quarter for this? Reply 'not now' and I'll check back.}}

{{RANDOM | Thanks for the time, | Appreciate the time, | Thanks,}}
Lorenzo

variants.subject: lost bids
variants.body:
{{RANDOM | Hey | Hi}} {{firstName}},

{{RANDOM | Last one from me on this. | Closing the loop on this. | One more, then I'll leave it alone.}} Most cleaning companies I talk to have 20 to 60 proposals from the last two years that never got a yes or a no. {{RANDOM | That list is usually the fastest money in the building. | Those are the easiest contracts to win back. | That is where the cheapest revenue sits.}}

I run a follow-up sequence to every one of them under {{companyName}}'s name, and the ones that are ready book a walkthrough on your calendar. Nothing up front, commission on what comes back.

{{RANDOM | Reply with a rough count of lost bids and I'll tell you what I'd expect to come back. | Send me roughly how many lost bids you have and I'll give you a realistic recovery number. | Reply with a rough count and I'll tell you which are worth chasing.}}

{{RANDOM | Thanks, | Appreciate it,}}
Lorenzo

P.S. A lender ran the same follow-up mechanics on a $1.5k build and turned it into a $5M pipeline. Different industry, same math.
